status: Retrospective exploratory protocol fixed before this experiment; all years were available to earlier project analyses, not a fresh confirmatory test
question: What simple observable conditions and target-label fitting budgets permit positive China-Australia transfer relative to target-only learners?
target: Unweighted within-FUA mean of the existing SatPM cell-month target, not regulatory ground truth
aggregation: Aggregate grid cells to one FUA-month before modelling; retain every FUA-month and retain rejected observations for auditing
label_accounting: Record fitting labels, rule-discovery labels (240 per split), and confirmation labels separately. A source-only regressor with a target-discovered gate is not a zero-label deployment procedure.
gate_search: Unrestricted, every single threshold, and conjunctions from the best 12 eligible single thresholds. Comparators evaluated on identical selected observations.
discovery_positive_transfer: At least 5% RMSE reduction versus the best of mean/ridge/LightGBM target-only baselines on the same gate and fitting labels, with positive improvement in both discovery years
gate_selection: Among passing rules prefer fewer conditions, then greater coverage, then larger relative improvement. If none pass, freeze the unrestricted best transfer candidate and record no discovery success.
confirmation: Frozen rule, model and comparator; >=5% RMSE improvement, coverage constraints, and positive lower 95% paired-bootstrap RMSE reduction. All stages reported even if a stage fails.
bootstrap: 1000 paired replicates, independent FUA and calendar-quarter multinomial cluster weights; exploratory intervals, not formal post-selection or time-series guarantees
unsupervised_support_gate: Portable distance <= source-only cross-FUA 95th percentile; empirical support proxy, not an exact reproduction of Meyer-Pebesma AOA
interpretation: Retrospective reconstruction: POWER and EDGAR covariates are annual and are carried from 2022 into 2023-2024 in the inherited panel
Meteorological predicates describe observed associations, not proven causal mechanisms
Passing one direction does not establish reverse transfer
Do not call the minimum tested passing budget a universal minimum
The final manuscript is not overwritten by this exploratory branch
